newsitem.title: USA: US junk bond deal levels rich but value still seen.
newsitem.headline: US junk bond deal levels rich but value still seen.

text.p: U.S. high-yield issuance promises to reveal more and more aggressive levels as the week draws on, dealers said, with little protest from the investor community.

Even some high-yield credits that may test the 200 basis point spread level are bargains compared to where they would have been before March's correction, they said. In addition, credits have all been stable -- those with little or no cash flow stories have yet to make a reentry to the junk market.
"The correction is surely over but the market is still not where it was six-weeks ago," said the head of capital markets at a New York investment firm.
